title: Article 46 — Educational and economic interests of weaker sections

content.heading: Promotion of educational and economic interests of Scheduled Castes, Scheduled Tribes and other weaker sections
content.text: The State shall promote with special care the educational and economic interests of the weaker sections of the people, and in particular of the Scheduled Castes and the Scheduled Tribes, and shall protect them from social injustice and all forms of exploitation.
